conclusions.title: Operational tools exist; measured AI impact remains unknown
conclusions.statement: ICC crew-prediction support and Jetstream were announced in 2024. A 2026 company statement describes improvement without establishing quantified attribution to those tools.
missing_evidence: Costs, counterfactuals and independent outcome evidence
conclusions.change_from_v2: V3 connects a dated deployment account with a later qualitative statement while keeping the measured-outcome gap open.

conclusions.title: Maintenance analysis starts with an existing ecosystem
conclusions.statement: The 2023 S.FP+/Skywise launch-customer reference establishes historical supplier context. It does not establish current incumbency across all maintenance, an available replacement contract or a new procurement event.
missing_evidence: Current product scope and contract boundaries
conclusions.change_from_v2: Adds located product/dependency evidence and a bounded supplier relationship, instead of assuming a blank-slate maintenance platform.

conclusions.title: Fuel regulation needs entity-specific responsibility mapping
conclusions.statement: The official registration condition is industry context. Determine the relevant fuel-supply role before assigning a compliance responsibility or transformation need to easyJet.
missing_evidence: Applicable easyJet legal entity and fuel-supply activities
Supply contracts, reporting and assurance responsibility
conclusions.change_from_v2: V3 explicitly keeps policy context at Industry scope and makes the missing enterprise applicability relationship visible.

conclusions.title: A dated outcome baseline adds context, not AI causality
conclusions.statement: H1 FY2026 disclosure provides a half-year financial comparator and an on-time performance measure. Use these bounded outcomes alongside operating context; do not compare a seasonal half-year loss with FY2025 full-year profit or attribute OTP to ICC AI.
missing_evidence: Later FY2026 results and period comparability
Metric definition, disruption mix and independent causal assessment
conclusions.change_from_v2: Adds a directly retrieved H1 report where the previous current-results landing page yielded only a shell; establishes an operating metric while leaving Q3 original-release verification outstanding.

source_limitations.status: Direct page returns a financial shell, not the underlying Q3 release; index-only limitation preserved

follow_up_tasks.question: Use dated H1 OTP as a bounded baseline; obtain disruption mix, utilisation, ICC/Jetstream adoption and comparable periods before attributing outcomes to AI.
follow_up_tasks.reason: A measured OTP level and qualitative ICC improvement now exist, but attribution and later-period validity do not.

follow_up_tasks.question: Identify the applicable legal entity, fuel ownership/supply role, supplier contracts and reporting/assurance boundaries before assigning a fuel-mandate responsibility.
follow_up_tasks.reason: The policy condition is industry context; enterprise applicability is still missing.

follow_up_tasks.question: Retrieve the original Q3 release and independent market/regulator comparators; separate seasonal H1 performance and historical maintenance dependencies from industry-wide conclusions.
follow_up_tasks.reason: The H1 source improves enterprise context; it cannot fill every current-results, supplier or industry-comparison gap.
